message.content: In the conversation, Emily expresses enthusiasm about how the series is helping her understand the characters better. Specifically, during a discussion about the series "The Rings of Power," Emily mentions, "I really love how they are bringing Middle-earth to life. My favorite part so far has been the emphasis on character development and their backstories. It feels like we’re really getting to know them!" This indicates that she appreciates the series' focus on character development and backstory, which allows viewers to connect more deeply with the characters.
